subject: Action roadmap & evaluation kickoff for IronDelta pilot
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@irondelta.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Action roadmap & evaluation kickoff for IronDelta pilot

Hi Samira,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — excited to get the pilot moving. I wanted to introduce the team and propose a short, actionable roadmap so we can align on who does what and close timeline expectations.

High-level goal: validate Redwood inference for IronDelta’s internal research assistant (R&D helpdesk) with latency <= 200ms p95 for targeted queries and embedding similarity quality above your current baseline.

Proposed 6-week evaluation timeline (draft):
- Week 0 (this week): kickoff, stakeholder roster, access + security checklist
- Weeks 1–3: integration & ingestion, baseline traffic tests, initial quality checks
- Weeks 4–5: focused evals, prompt iterations, cost/perf tuning
- Week 6: final run, results review, decision checkpoint (go/no-go)

Attachments: RDW-IronDelta-MAP-draft-v1.pdf (MAP with milestones) and Pilot-SOW-outline.docx (scope/assumptions). Please review and tell us if the timeline or success criteria need to change.

Action items for you to confirm:
1) Primary champion for IronDelta (I have Samira listed) and backup decision-maker for approvals
2) Technical owner for integration and Slack/email for daily syncs
3) Any required pre-kickoff compliance docs beyond SOC2 / data retention (if yes, flag and we’ll prioritize)

We can run a 30-minute kickoff tomorrow at 11:00 PT if that works — otherwise propose a few times and we’ll adjust.

Thanks,
Olga
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183
Redwood Inference

--

Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Action roadmap & evaluation kickoff for IronDelta pilot

Hi Olga — thanks for the clear plan and for the attachments. Confirming I’ll be the primary champion for this pilot; Ilya Novik (Head of Research Platforms) will be the technical owner on our side and should be on the integration calls.

Timeline looks reasonable but would prefer the final checkpoint moved one week later (end of Week 7) so we have time to reconcile IRB-style input from our compliance team if needed. Can we target the decision checkpoint for 7 Jun instead of 31 May?

Compliance note: we do require a short data handling Q&A and evidence of token retention settings for any third-party inference provider. Please have privacy/compliance contact share that checkbox doc before integration.

I’m available for the 11:00 PT slot tomorrow.

Best,
Samira Khan
Sr. Director, Data Science — IronDelta Therapeutics

Hi Samira, Olga — great to e-meet. Thanks for confirming details, Samira. Ilya, welcome (looping you here in case you want to add to the tech checklist).

Quick additions from the AE side:
- We’ve attached a one-page MAP table in the PDF with owners for each line item. I’ll take point on weekly status and coordinating Redwood resources (runtime access, model selection, quantization recommendations).
- For success metrics, could you share one or two example queries or decision points you’ll use to evaluate quality? Even a short seed set helps us tune the model and provide deterministic baselines.
- Regarding compliance: Olga, Marissa — can we get privacy/compliance to send the retention checklist that Samira requested? I’ll add a placeholder in the MAP for compliance review.

Proposed next steps:
1) Kickoff call tomorrow 11:00 PT (30 min) — I’ll share dial-in and a short run of show
2) Samira / Ilya to confirm access (S3 bucket / sample queries) by Friday 21 May
3) Marissa to open onboarding playbook items and schedule first 1:1 with IronDelta IT

I’ll post the calendar invite in a minute.

Thanks,
